Scan sources

Sites marked BLOCKED or FAILED refuse automated robots — the daily scan cannot read them, so check those by hand once in a while via their Search manually link.

Watched sites

Career pages you want the daily scan to watch for new openings.

Office directories

Add a job manually

Spotted an opening somewhere the scan doesn’t cover? Track it here — it appears in the Jobs tab immediately.

Save manual_jobs.json into G:\My Drive\job\jobtracker\ (Mac: the same jobtracker folder in Google Drive) so the daily scan persists these jobs into the database permanently.

Backup & sync

Browser storage is per machine — your statuses and notes on Windows are not automatically on the Mac. Export here, then import on the other computer to move everything across.

The backup contains: job statuses & notes, company applied-flags & notes, manually added jobs, watched sites, your reference location, theme and active tab. Importing merges — imported values win on conflict.
